traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria and listed requirements for Story 002.0-DEV-ESLINT-CONFIG are implemented and verified:
- Core Functionality: `configs.recommended` and `configs.strict` are implemented as ESLint v9 flat-config arrays and are tested to enable the plugin’s rules when spread after a plugins registration object (REQ-CONFIG-PRESETS, REQ-FLAT-CONFIG). - Quality Standards: Implementation and docs follow ESLint v9 flat-config best practices (flat array configuration, JS/TS integration, monorepo patterns) as described in user-docs/eslint-9-setup-guide.md and used in tests. - Integration: FlatESLint-based tests demonstrate the presets working seamlessly with existing configs; dynamic rule loading ensures all rules are available; documentation shows integration patterns for JS, TS, and mixed projects (REQ-PROJECT-INTEGRATION). - User Experience & Documentation: README.md and the ESLint 9 Setup Guide provide clear setup instructions, multiple configuration examples, and a troubleshooting guide tailored to common flat-config issues. - Error Handling: Configuration schemas restrict allowed properties and types; tests confirm ESLint produces clear, descriptive errors for unknown options and wrong types (REQ-CONFIG-VALIDATION, Error Handling acceptance criterion). - Customizable Paths and Rule Options: valid-story-reference supports configurable story directories, extensions, and absolute path behavior with comprehensive tests; per-rule schemas expose options such as `storyDirectories`, `allowAbsolutePaths`, `requireStoryExtension`, `scope`, and `exportPriority` (REQ-CUSTOMIZABLE-PATHS, REQ-RULE-OPTIONS).
Given the stable story text, existing traceability annotations, and a passing full test run that includes all Story 002.0-specific test suites, this story is fully implemented and passes its requirements.
